name: Elemental Hands
body:
Rather than positive or negative energy only, you can channel elemental energy through your touch.

Prerequisites: Fervor or lay on hands class feature, non-neutral alignment on the good-evil axis, worshiper of a deity granting the Air, Earth, Fire, Water or Weather domain.

Benefit: Select an energy type matching a domain granted by your deity. You can use your fervor or lay on hands ability to deal the same amount of energy damage, instead of positive or negative energy damage. If your ability uses positive energy, you inflict elemental damage to evil creatures; if it uses negative energy, you inflict elemental damage to good creatures.

Creatures who are neutral on the good-evil axis take half damage.

Special: Paladins can select this feat in place of a mercy.
